purpose: Illustrative fixtures for structural schema and semantic conformance checks.

fixtures.reason: One component realizes responsibilities in multiple layers.
Responsibility refers to a non-existent core layer.
Semantic checker must detect duplicate IDs across the elements collection.

Status value is outside the allowed DUSRM vocabulary.

notes: Fixtures are authored but not run against a JSON Schema validator.
Semantic-fail fixtures may pass structural schema validation and must be rejected by a future semantic checker.
Fixture creation is not a conformance or certification result.
